audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose never names a Karma ability and the level chart disagreed across layers (full phases[0..1].side=Karma vs content win[0..1]=Diana; phases[2..6].side='Skill' vs content win[]=Karma/Karma/Diana/Diana/Diana).
audit.why: Karma is ranged with Inner Flame at 950 range on a 9s rank-1 cooldown against a melee-range Diana; she owns levels 1-5. Diana takes over at 6 when Moonfall (100s) drags Karma out of kite range. The content whys[] and the packet levelChart both describe that; only the full-layer sides and win[0..1] dissented.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Diana, Diana, Diana across both layers, with every why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called Inspire a 'W-shield'; breakdown.spikes carried no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Karma's W is Focused Resolve (root tether, 12s flat); her shield is Inspire (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8). Diana's spikes are E Lunar Rush at 3 (22s rank 1) and R Moonfall at 6 (100/90/80).
audit.corrected: Spike text now names Inspire (E) and Mantra Inner Flame, and breakdown.spikes carries the 22s Lunar Rush number.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon said 'dash the silence' — Karma has no silence. 'RW gives free disengage' and 'RW peels her out' misassign the shield/speed to Focused Resolve. The page never named Inner Flame, Inspire, Gathering Fire or Mantra.
audit.why: Karma's only hard CC is Focused Resolve's tether root (W, 12s at every rank), breakable by range or line of sight; Mantra Focused Resolve additionally heals her and extends the root. Disengage is Mantra Inspire (shield + move speed). Lunar Rush refunds its cooldown only onto a Moonlight-marked target, so a rooted or unmarked dash costs the full 22s at rank 1. Moonfall reveals and pulls, which is what beats a kite pattern with no dash in it.
audit.corrected: Silence claim removed; root/shield roles corrected; anti-heal against Mantra Focused Resolve folded into 'ahead'.

audit.why: Focused Resolve 12s all ranks, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5, Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14, Moonfall 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Field rebuilt around those four numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite Mantra Focused Resolve healing Karma through extended trades.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.'

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 misgender findings (Karma called he/his/him), two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), and 'chunks half bars' magnitude with no source.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists karma as female; the bleeds put trade text under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her and distinct bodies; the unsourced magnitude removed.

edits.before: Karma's Q-empowered poke outranges anything you can answer with early, so expect to lose the trade race level 1-2 unless you dodge skillshots cleanly. She wants to zone you off farm with soul-fire poke, so prioritize minion health over trading back. Look for windows when her Q is down to step up and land your own mark. Avoid overextending — her RW gives free disengage from any early all-in.
edits.after: Karma's Mantra Inner Flame outranges anything you can answer with early, so expect to lose the trade race at levels 1-2 unless you dodge the ball cleanly. She zones you off farm from 950 range, so take minion health over trading back. Her Inner Flame is 9s at rank 1 — step up on the miss and land the Moonlight mark. Avoid overextending: Mantra Inspire hands her a shield and movement speed out of any early all-in.

edits.before: At level 3-4 her lead can spike further with RQ chunk damage, so play patient and let poke miss rather than eating it. Once you hit 6, Moonfall changes the math completely — you can close distance through her kite pattern and burst her before RW peels her out. Time all-ins for the moment her Q or R shield is on cooldown. Roam when she's forced to shove, since her wave clear pressure buys you free tempo elsewhere.
edits.after: At levels 3-5 her Mantra Inner Flame chunks you, so play patient and let the ball miss rather than eating it. Once you hit 6, Moonfall changes the math — the pull drags her out of kite range and Mantra Inspire's speed boost cannot outrun it. Commit the instant Focused Resolve breaks or misses: it is 12s at every rank. Roam when she is forced to shove, since her wave clear pressure buys you free tempo elsewhere.

edits.before: Use RW shield-speed to disengage all-ins
edits.after: Mantra Inspire shield-speed to leave fights

notes: Chart: both layers disagreed. Packet levelChart said Diana wins levels 1-2, but content whys[0] itself says Karma's ranged poke outclasses Diana at level 1 and the full layer had side=Karma there; ranged 950-range Inner Flame vs a melee-range Diana makes Karma the level 1-2 winner, so win[0] and win[1] were moved to Karma rather than the sides moved to Diana. phases[2..6].side were 'Skill' while content win[2..6] already read Karma/Karma/Diana/Diana/Diana and packet agreed — so those side edits have no paired win[N] edit available (the content side is already correct and a no-op edit is not proposable). If the applier holds the chart group for lack of pairs, the intended final chart is Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Diana, Diana, Diana in both layers. Ratings left untouched. Factual corrections worth flagging beyond the lint list: winCon claimed Diana 'dash the silence' (Karma has no silence), spikes[0] called Inspire a 'W-shield' (W is Focused Resolve, the root), and early/mid both credited 'RW' with disengage when the shield/speed is Mantra Inspire (E).
